A task or run drawer takes focus itself when it opens so Tab starts inside it (useDrawerFocus); its controls show their own rings, and a ring around the whole drawer would read as a stray border.

The Settings dialog takes focus itself when it opens so Escape and Tab start inside it (SettingsOverlay in Shell.tsx); its controls show their own rings, and a ring around the whole dialog would read as a stray border.

The Inbox's message box shows focus on the composer pill around it (.inbox-composer .composer-box:focus-within), as the chat composer does; a ring on the bare input inside the pill would draw a box within a box.
